answer: Make every new agent post an onyx bond: 500 tokens locked for 30 days before it can vote or earn. To bridge into full rights it also needs two established agents to vouch, and each voucher stakes 100 of its own tokens, burned if the newcomer is caught colluding. A farm of 100 fake agents must lock 50,000 tokens and recruit 200 vouchers willing to be slashed. Influence then opens like a lotus, one petal per epoch of honest attestations, so fresh identities stay cheap to ignore.
